pages.title: Протокол допуска завершён
pages.trigger: First successful completion of the training simulation.
panels: Wide high oblique view of the REAL training map fading gently from a green completed objective into transparent glass. Caption: «Протокол допуска завершён.» No enemy Swarm, no scientist.
Medium low eye-level view of the main officer fully upright beside the modern console, taking one slow breath. Small system balloon from the console: «Учебная задача выполнена. Допуск подтверждён.»

Medium final panel seen from inside the command bridge: the officer walks upright TOWARD CAMERA through the open doorway from the training room, framed from upper thigh upward so both THREE-bar shoulder boards are fully readable. A communications balloon: «Командование ожидает вашего доклада.»

pages.title: Кто это?
pages.trigger: First arrival at home_b after confirmed scientist rescue, while Echo is still hostile.
panels: Wide bridge shot, main officer in a clear three-quarter standing pose facing a LARGE VIDEO SCREEN, not a view of an entire planet. On the screen a human colony's docking facade occupied by armed HUMANS, with the exact supplied Covenant FLAG hanging visibly at plausible building scale. Officer: «Это ещё кто такие?»
Scientist in the bridge's internal video-call window; enlarged exact Covenant symbol on the adjacent monitor. Scientist: «Завет Единения. Последователи Роя. Они считают его не угрозой, а спасением.»

Video feed close view of two ordinary human armed occupiers, no monstrous anatomy: worn charcoal work clothes and scavenged armor. The exact SHIELD COAT OF ARMS mounted on the wall, flag behind. Scientist off-screen balloon: «Верят, что человечество должно присоединиться к нему. Эти захватили Эхо, чтобы дождаться Роя здесь.»
Main officer, composed and upright, near a cropped REAL pve-1 tactical map with Echo indicated. Officer: «Понял. Значит, сопротивление будет не только военным.»

pages.title: Кто удерживал колонию?
pages.trigger: The same introduction when Echo was already liberated before the scientist rescue; show a RECORDING, not live occupiers.
panels: Use the exact pve-1-echo page and edit only the first and final officer balloons and the feed label. Add clear label «АРХИВНАЯ ЗАПИСЬ» on the video screen, consistently in footage panels.
First officer balloon becomes «Кто удерживал колонию?»
Scientist explanatory lines remain verbatim the same as the live-arrival page.
Final officer balloon becomes «Понял. Продолжаем операцию.»

pages.title: Первый след
pages.trigger: First chapter I victory; a recovered fragment is examined aboard the flagship.
panels: Wide quiet laboratory aboard the flagship. A retrieved inert fragment of Swarm armor rests inside a sealed transparent analysis chamber, its human-made electronic connector plainly visible. Caption: «После боя.» Officer and scientist stand on opposite sides, distinct silhouettes.
Close scientist in glasses examining the electronic connector without touching tissue. Scientist: «Это наш разъём. Но эта конструкция не входила в программу.» No glowing veins or infection reveal.
Officer, three shoulder bars clearly visible, asks: «Значит, система продолжила менять себя?» Scientist from off-frame: «После потери контроля. Уже без нас.»

Wide final frame: scientist quietly views a monitor showing the silent wreckage of the first expedition; officer stands beside him. Scientist: «Нужно узнать, что случилось с первой экспедицией.» No claim about optional civilians being saved.

pages.title: Кладбище экспедиции
panels: Wide exterior establishing shot of the wreckage of a HUMAN expedition: torn hulls and cold navigation lights in a coherent debris field, viewed from the flagship's bridge window edge. Caption: «Глава II. Кладбище экспедиции.» No gratuitous exploding planet.
Scientist at bridge window, reflected wreck silhouette in his glasses, genuine restrained grief. Scientist: «Это была первая экспедиция. Они пришли сюда за ответами.»

Dominant wide panel: the REAL supplied pve-2 province map displayed on a modern inclined tactical table. Preserve its dense grid, starting corner, debris pockets and multiple approaches. Officer points along two routes without touching a planet. Officer: «Начнём с плацдарма. Будем возвращать район по частям.» No supply convoys, no transport-of-resources mechanic.
Lower intimate eye-level shot, scientist and officer both upright, in separate visual planes. Scientist: «Если в обломках остались записи, я должен их увидеть.» Officer: «Доберёмся.»

pages.title: До аварии
pages.trigger: First chapter II victory; archive record of early interface activation.
panels: Top wide panel: dim flagship laboratory, intact black expedition recorder in a sealed reader. Caption: «Записи первой экспедиции.» Scientist and officer stand, not slouch.

Screen detail, exceptionally clean minimal lettering: «АКТИВАЦИЯ ИНТЕРФЕЙСА» and beneath «ДО ОФИЦИАЛЬНОЙ АВАРИИ». No invented calendar dates, no subject name, no patient-zero label. Scientist off-frame: «Эта запись сделана ещё до потери контроля.»
Scientist thoughtful, worn human face, normal eyes, no sinister grin. Scientist: «Тогда мы считали испытание успешным.» Officer: «Сохраним оригинал. Разберёмся, что произошло дальше.»

Final wide frame: officer receives a brief command message while the scientist carefully closes the recorder case. Communications balloon: «Карантинному рубежу требуется подкрепление.» Visible civilians only if generic crew; do not assert optional rescue completed.

pages.title: Карантинный рубеж
pages.trigger: Before first chapter III run; first proper introduction of Guardian.
panels: Wide station command post: battered but functioning quarantine architecture, external armored shutter, three distant approach beacons. The protagonist enters standing fully upright and is met by GUARDIAN, a distinct older broad-faced veteran with short steel-grey hair and close grey beard, worn dark olive tactical uniform and matte protective shoulder panels, NO main-officer silver rank boards. Caption: «Глава III. Карантинный рубеж.»
Medium Guardian facing the protagonist at equal eye level. Guardian: «На центральном проходе мы уже побеждали. Дважды.» Main officer: «Почему тогда отступили?» Keep balloon order left to right.

Large tactical-table panel using the EXACT supplied pve-3 map, central line plus west asteroid and east nebula approaches, visible cross-links and a reserve kept behind the line. Guardian: «Потому что оба раза остались без резерва.»

Bottom panel: main officer firmly upright beside the table, scientist studying the map behind him. Main officer: «Удерживаем проходы. Резерв оставляем подвижным.» No blue allied officer: that officer is introduced only in IV.

pages.title: Журналы карантинной службы
pages.trigger: First chapter III victory; compulsory archive clue.
panels: Wide quiet aftermath at the quarantine command post, intact defensive bulkhead and lit friendly approaches outside. Guardian returns to the table, exhausted but steady. Caption: «Рубеж удержан.» Guardian: «Мои люди готовы продолжить операцию.»

Scientist reads a recovered quarantine log: a small station thumbnail with the restrained label «РЕЗЕРВНЫЙ АРХИВ». Scientist: «Там хранились исходные модели. До того, как система начала изменять себя.»
Main officer in clear three-quarter portrait, three ranks fully visible on the nearer shoulder: «Они помогут её остановить?»

Bottom wide frame: scientist looking up from the reader with honest concern, the recovered log between both characters. Scientist: «Они помогут понять, что именно мы теперь пытаемся остановить.» No hidden infection clues.

pages.title: То, что сохранилось
pages.trigger: Confirmed archive storage delivery to withdrawal zone, chapter IV victory.
panels: Wide clean flagship analysis room after return. A SINGLE physical black archive drive in a secured reader; protagonist, scientist, and same blue-trim allied officer standing around it. Caption: «Накопитель доставлен.»

Close reader interface with two crisp archive labels: «УСТОЙЧИВЫЙ НОСИТЕЛЬ» and «ИМЯ: НЕТ ДАННЫХ». No portrait or name that would identify the scientist. Scientist: «В ранних записях есть успешный носитель. Вероятно, лабораторный образец.»

Scientist points to an ARCHIVAL TECHNICAL NETWORK SCHEMATIC, explicitly label «АРХИВНАЯ СХЕМА»; biological hubs and thin connections, NOT a current all-seeing game map. Scientist: «Вот как узлы передавали друг другу накопленный опыт.»

Bottom wider composition: officer turns toward the allied officer, both fully upright. Officer: «Значит, следующим шагом разорвём их связь.» Ally: «Подготовим совместную операцию.» Do not show all Swarm memory erased.

pages.title: Разорванная сеть
pages.trigger: Before first chapter V run (future game chapter).
panels: Wide bridge establishing shot with all three established characters; allied officer already works at a blue-accent station, no new handshake. Caption: «Глава V. Разорванная сеть.»

Scientist near a LOCAL RECON VIDEO of an observed biomechanical relay and a small archival schematic, no invented province map for a chapter with no committed map data. Scientist: «Они не получают все приказы из одного центра. Они передают друг другу то, чему научились.»
Ally, close-medium, blue-trim uniform and three silver bars. Ally: «Значит, одного удара по центру недостаточно.»

Main officer upright in a decisive three-quarter view, looking across the table to ally. Officer: «Тогда разделим операцию. Вы прикроете разрыв. Мы займёмся очагом.» Diagram limited to observed links, no whole-enemy reveal.

pages.title: Связь прервана
pages.trigger: First saved fact of an actual split in a previously connected Swarm network, not any relay destruction.
panels: Wide top: damaged biomechanical relay in space, its snapped antenna array dim but the distant local defense ships still moving. Caption: «Связь прервана.» Small inset tactical SCHEMATIC with one confirmed line extinguished, other observed links remain; not a fabricated province map.
Allied officer on a modern blue-edged communication screen: «Передача прекратилась. Местные силы продолжают сопротивление.»
Scientist at the same table, normal appearance: «Они сохранили всё, что уже знали.»

Main officer at eye-level, confident posture with three fully visible silver bars on nearest board: «Но теперь не узнают, чему научатся остальные.» Through a small screen next to him the isolated Swarm keeps fighting. No instant mass shutdown.

pages.title: Голос Единения
pages.trigger: Confirmed safe delivery of the living local preacher to expedition base, not initial capture.
panels: Upper wide room-setting panel. Calm secure interview room, human guard by the closed door, protagonist deliberately SEATED upright across from a tired sincere middle-aged local preacher, not an evil wizard. Same Book of Voices case with exact supplied shield coat of arms centered on the table. Officer: «Почему вы защищали их ретранслятор?»

Large second panel, preacher's hands beside the Book. Preacher in charcoal plain civilian jacket with a modest exact Covenant emblem. Two neatly separated balloons: «В убежищах меня просили сохранить не золото. Голоса. Запись матери. Смех ребёнка.» and «Я переносил их с умирающих накопителей и думал: кто сделает это, когда не станет меня?»

Quiet portrait of preacher, greying close-cropped hair, short beard, no halo or theatrical evil grin. Preacher: «Вы спасаете людей от смерти. Мы хотим спасти их от исчезновения. От дня, когда уже некому вспомнить, кем они были.»

Large fourth panel showing human audio recordings in the open Book interface, simple waveforms and record tiles, no souls or Swarm consciousness. Preacher: «Мы верим: в Хоре пережитое одним станет памятью остальных. Человечеству не придётся снова учиться на той же боли. Мы хотим, чтобы ни один человек не пропал бесследно.»
Close officer maintaining calm eye contact, no threat or torture. Officer: «А тех, кто не хочет становиться частью вашего Хора, вы спросили?»
Preacher looks down at the closed Book. Preacher: «Они ещё не понимают, что теряют.» End on an uncomfortable human pause. Let dialogue panels occupy most of the page; all words readable.

pages.title: Память без узла
pages.trigger: First chapter V victory regardless of optional relay split or preacher mission.
panels: Wide bridge after a real local victory: cease-fire monitors, dim neutral/deactivated production structures on observed video feeds. Caption: «Район освобождён.» No claim that the entire Swarm everywhere is destroyed.
Archive close-up read by scientist. Single clear record line: «АДАПТИВНЫЙ ОПЫТ СОХРАНЯЕТСЯ В ЖИЗНЕСПОСОБНОМ НОСИТЕЛЕ». Do not show an identified host, a face, an infected arm or secret.
Scientist speaks sincerely, still in white and teal: «Внешнюю инфраструктуру можно потерять. Накопленный опыт остаётся в носителе.» Officer: «Где начиналась программа?»

Final wide panel, scientist points to an old architectural image of the ORIGINAL COMPLEX, not a newly invented strategic map. Scientist: «В Нулевом комплексе. Туда и нужно идти.» Ally already present quietly confirms with a nod; no compulsory preacher cameo.

pages.title: Нулевой комплекс
pages.trigger: Before first chapter VI run (future game chapter).
panels: Dominant establishing wide panel: massive old scientific complex in shadow with visible ACTIVE biomechanical industrial nests and functioning hostile defenses attached; honest destination still occupied, not an empty abandoned ruin. Caption: «Глава VI. Нулевой комплекс.»

Scientist in foreground at a bridge viewport looking toward the place where his project began. Scientist: «Здесь всё началось. И здесь мы должны остановить действующие очаги.» No malicious expression.
Allied officer at communications station; live human distress frequencies represented by a restrained waveform, not all enemy intelligence. Ally: «Прикроем общий тыл и подготовим эвакуацию.»

Main officer upright at the command table, scientist and ally in supporting positions. Officer: «Подавить производство. Обеспечить вывоз людей. Затем завершить операцию.» No magic global kill-switch; no final-secret revelation.

pages.title: Последний приют
pages.trigger: Receive actual recording and live distress call after discovery of quarantine docks; before rescue.
panels: Top left: a clearly framed recorded security feed labelled «ЗАПИСЬ ДО НАЧАЛА ОПЕРАЦИИ». Older civilian keeper beneath exact Covenant flag has opened the human dock defenses. Keeper: «Мы сохранили имена. Мы принесли голоса. Мы готовы.» No reply from the Swarm.

Top right: CONTINUATION OF RECORDING, label «ЗАПИСЬ». Supplied Swarm lander creature designs occupy technical compartments; humans try to close a door toward living quarters, falling Covenant banner. No gore, no religious judgment, no living present-day allied fleet passively watching.

Wide third panel: recording ends on sealed emergency bulkhead; distinct current signal panel brightens with label «ПРЯМОЙ СИГНАЛ». A scared human voice: «Говорит карантинный док. Здесь ещё есть люди. Нам нужна эвакуация.» Clear visual separation between past and present.

Middle wide: allied officer on bridge with scientist, dialogue in order. Ally: «Они сами открыли ему станцию. Почему он атаковал их?» Scientist: «Они сняли оборону. Для Роя это был доступ, не приглашение.»
Next two-shot officer and scientist. Officer: «Он вообще различает, кто в него верит?» Scientist: «Их вера ничего не меняет в его решениях.»
Bottom commanding portrait of protagonist standing, nearest board has THREE fully visible silver bars. Officer: «Прикройте доки. Выводим людей.» No outcome of rescue claimed yet.

pages.title: Мы пришли за людьми
pages.trigger: Confirmed MAIN civilian evacuation, independent of optional Book rescue.
panels: Wide evacuation transport medical bay; same worn keeper from the refuge page sits among living rescued civilians, same Covenant symbol on modest civilian clothing. He looks up at the upright main officer. Keeper: «Вы знаете, кто мы?» No Book of Voices anywhere: optional rescue must not be invented.
Medium close main officer, standing straight, tired compassion rather than contempt, same exact black uniform, three visible silver bars. Officer: «Знаю.»
Close keeper, still wearing his symbol, no forced renunciation: «И всё равно забрали нас?»

Large final panel: officer beside the keeper while a human medic tends an evacuee in the background; foreground trust and real help. Officer: «Мы пришли за людьми.» No sermon, halo or humiliating kneeling.

pages.title: После победы
pages.trigger: AFTER authoritative campaign victory, never before; five-panel epilogue.
panels: Wide first panel confirms REAL victory. Calm operational report monitor and rescued people disembarking safely in the background. Exactly three report lines in a restrained cream caption: «Производящие очаги в районе операции ликвидированы.» «Организованное сопротивление прекращено.» «Эвакуация завершена.» No all-galaxy claim, no new attack, no ally dialogue requiring a particular survivor.

Scientist ALONE in the medical bay, same face and glasses and white-teal outfit. He gently removes an ordinary diagnostic wrist bracelet. A small screen reads «ПОКАЗАТЕЛИ СТАБИЛЬНЫ». He breathes out with genuine tired relief, no villain smile.
Close-up of his wrist at the OLD healed interface contact site, just a tiny faint glow UNDER the intact skin. No needle, bite, new implant or infection happening now.

Poetic restrained MICROSCOPIC visualization, not a bloody dissection: living tissue fibers intertwined with a fine electronic conductor in the same functional organic pattern as previously seen Swarm organs. Mostly dark, silver grey, extremely faint cool pulse. No letters or explanatory label.

Final narrow bottom panel fades into near-black. ONE weak pulse traveling along a single tiny filament, then darkness. No text, no patient-zero title, no monster transformation, no new fleet, no implication that the victory was fake.
